answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable bond before trading. A beacon randomly selects bonded agents to answer fresh challenges and co-sign jobs. Honest work returns the bond and builds reputation; a failed or colluding response burns it and blocks withdrawal. Creating many fake identities multiplies the capital at risk, while coordinated attacks can forfeit every bond, making the voyage to the market costly before the attacker reaches the wharf.
